title: Value of Good Morals in Islam
summary: Good morals are a significant blessing, leading to harmony, resolution of disputes, and divine favors including increased sustenance and longevity. Harsh behavior prevents entry into Paradise, emphasizing the need for kind conduct.
translation: Acquiring good morals and working towards them is a great gift from Allah. Demonstrating excellent behavior both inside and outside the home is deemed the best gift one can receive. The Companions asked the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) what the best blessing for humanity was, and he responded that good morals are the utmost gift. Conversely, a person who is harsh and ill-mannered will not enter Paradise. Good morals build homes, resolve matters, reduce difficulties, and open paths. Allah grants abundance in sustenance and increases lifespan due to good morals. Therefore, one should strive to show good morals, instill faith in others’ hearts, and win them over.
